changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.comment: Optional node per property. NULL ha_node_name is a shared row that applies to all nodes; a named row applies to that node only. Existing rows keep a NULL node and stay shared.

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.comment: The key becomes (property_key, ha_node_name) with NULLS NOT DISTINCT: at most one shared row and at most one row per node for a key. Writers upsert with ON CONFLICT (property_key, ha_node_name). One-way: the previous per-key unique index is not kept because it would block a node row for any key that has a shared row. No rollback, no compatibility window; PostgreSQL 15 is the minimum.
